name: Asin API
description: Track Amazon prices and products: a watchlist checked on schedule, with price history and alerts. Authenticate with a personal API key from your account (Bearer token). Each price check of a tracked product costs 1 credit; a product checked daily uses about 30 credits a month. Failed checks are refunded. The same key works with the MCP server at /api/mcp and the Chrome extension.
